title: 'Umayuru Full Gate!' Short Anime Announced for September 2026
content: The official website for the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby franchise announced a new short anime, titled Umayuru Full Gate! , on Saturday. The short anime, produced by AtoriE , will premiere in September 2026 on the official Uma Musume YouTube Channel PakaTube! .
author: MyAnimeList

title: MURCIÉLAGO Anime Sets January 2027 Release
content: The TV anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura’s MURCIÉLAGO will officially begin broadcasting and streaming in January 2027. The announcement was made at Anime NYC, narrowing its previously announced 2027 release window. The adaptation was announced in July during Anime Expo 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: J-Novel Club Licenses 10 Light Novels, 1 Manga
content: J-Novel Club announced licenses for 10 light novel series and one manga at its Anime NYC panel on Saturday. The first two parts of the first volume for all new light novel series and the first chapter for the new manga are available now.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Action Fantasy Returns With New Look Ahead of Season 3
content: Crunchyroll is the largest streaming hub for anime fans across the globe, and it’s home to countless acclaimed series. One of the most stand-out hits on the platform is Wistoria: Wand and Sword , an action fantasy series centering around Will Serfort.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Isekai Confirms Release Date for Season 2 Return After 4 Years – Watch the Trailer
content: A major Isekai anime franchise has finally confirmed its release date for Season 2 after four long years of waiting, and HIDIVE has dropped a new trailer showing it off ahead of its big premiere.
